name: gta-v-2026-05-16
description: Ten minutes of a GTA V session, annotated by watching a contact sheet at 10-second intervals and then sampling at 3 seconds around anything that looked like an event. Written before running the pipeline over this window, so the labels owe nothing to what it found. A seed, not a comprehensive benchmark: one window of one recording of one game.

recordings.note: A cheat-enabled sandbox session, not a mission run: invincibility and weapon cheats are toggled repeatedly, and the notification box is busy throughout. Worth knowing before reading any number computed against it -- 'boring' here includes several stretches of standing in a hospital car park turning cheats on.

spans.note: WASTED. Present at 32:27 and 32:30, absent at 32:24, black by 32:33.
WASTED. Absent at 38:09, bright at 38:12, fading at 38:15, nearly gone at 38:18.
Driving a police car with wanted stars showing.
A vehicle explodes beside the player at 33:30.
Police helicopter overhead at 34:10, player firing up at it. Not a boss in the game's terms; labelled because it is the shape of encounter a highlight reel wants and no other type fits.
A vehicle flips and explodes at 35:20; debris in the air.
Large fire with police cars at 35:50.
Street firefight ending in the first death. Start is where the shooting begins; a reasonable person might start it ten seconds either side.
The strongest stretch in the window: carjacking, repeated explosions, a police helicopter, a five-star chase on foot. Anyone making a highlight reel from this recording takes something from here.
Hilltop firefight down onto the highway, ending in the second death.
Death fade, respawn, then standing in the hospital car park toggling cheats. Nothing happens and nothing is on screen but a notification list.
Driving between places. Not nothing -- there is still a wanted level -- but it is transit, and a 20-minute video does not want a minute of it.
The second respawn: black, hospital car park, cheat notifications.
Five stars showing across the whole action stretch.
Four stars while driving after the second respawn.
No stars drawn at all in the hospital car park. The row is hidden, which is the reading the profile calls absent_value.
